en.headline: 366 commits, 4 PRs and 52 issues across OpenCode skills and tooling
en.teaser: A month of building OpenCode skill tooling: a daily activity report, a deep-research skill family, a translation extension and a skill management plugin, plus upstream bug reports.
en.overview:
The window ran from 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-30 with data for every day; no dates are missing. Totals were 366 commits, 4 pull requests, 52 issues and 0 reviews, with 605 additional automated commits recorded separately.

### Own projects

Most of the work went into `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, where a daily GitHub activity report was built and then iterated: a Pages site with an AI summary, a workflow that accepts a manual date input, a switch to two-hour rolling updates, and a series of fixes to dark-mode readability, inline Markdown rendering in summaries and the headline contract. The deep-research skill `meld-deepresearch` was extended with a renderer, merge and validator steps, genre templates, explicit handling of access-blocked sources and a SenseNova capability gap analysis, and it shipped three releases up to v0.4.0. `sopen-translate` was started from scratch as an MV3 extension with a provider protocol layer, presets, glossary pipeline, chunked bilingual page rendering, a circuit breaker and smoke tests, with selection translation later dropped in favour of page translation only.

`opencode-skill-management` delivered the `skill_management` plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable actions, documentation revisions and a feasibility evaluation, and released v0.2.0, v1.0.0 and v1.1.0, the last moving all actions to a single JSON object with a declared output schema. `opencode-agent-sandbox` was initialised and filled with an AGENTS.md and a knowledge base covering OpenCode V2 distribution, architecture, authentication, Windows path pitfalls and remote branch handling. `opencode-go-model-picker` added agent-discovery and snapshot-summary scripts, atomic snapshot writes, version-drift checks and priced accounting, releasing v1.3.0, v1.4.0 and v2.0.0. `asset-inventory` corrected skill invocation facts across rules, samples and guides and released v1.15.4 and v1.15.5, while `myBlog` only gained OpenChamber capture screenshots.

### Upstream work

Upstream activity was mostly reporting. In `openchamber/openchamber` a long list of bugs and ideas was filed, covering storage management, the MCP settings list, session retention hints, quote-card navigation, file-view commenting, context panel breakdowns, browser capture resolution, issue linking and model thinking levels. In `anomalyco/opencode` the reports centred on MiMo vision models over the Go endpoint, subagent failures and the missing Windows CLI entry point. Smaller reports went to `alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim`, `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI`, `OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills` and `OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills-DeepResearch`. Four pull requests were closed in `antongulin/opencode-skill-creator`, covering CRLF frontmatter validation, platform-specific review URLs, review server disposal and eval robustness.

### Data notes

Earlier dates in this window were reconstructed through GitHub Search, so star counts are unavailable and release coverage is limited to the user's own repositories; issue and discussion figures for those dates are approximate.

highlights.text: Released v0.4.0, wrapping the six gate scripts behind a single meld.py command with prepare, render and review subcommands.
Released v1.1.0, changing all four skill_management actions to return one JSON object validated against a declared output schema.
Released v2.0.0 with priced accounting, quota-math references and a minimal install package.
Closed a pull request accepting CRLF line endings in skill frontmatter validation.
Opened a bug report that Settings > MCP omits the Console MCP server OpenCode adds at runtime.
Reported that mimo-v2.6-flash and mimo-v2.5 advertise image input while the Go endpoint rejects every image with a 400.
The daily report's AI narrative generation failed and was tracked in an ai-failure issue.

zh.headline: 366 次提交、4 个 PR、52 个 issue，聚焦 OpenCode 技能与工具
zh.teaser: 这个月主要搭建 OpenCode 技能工具链：每日活动日报、深度研究技能家族、翻译扩展和技能管理插件，同时向上游提交了大量缺陷报告。
zh.overview:
本窗口为 2026-10-01 至 2026-10-30，每天都有数据，没有缺失日期。总计 366 次提交、4 个 PR、52 个 issue、0 次评审，另有 605 次自动提交单独统计。

### 自有项目

主要精力放在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`，搭建并反复打磨每日 GitHub 活动日报：Pages 站点加 AI 摘要、工作流支持手动指定日期、改为每 2 小时滚动更新，并修复了深色模式可读性、摘要内联 Markdown 渲染和 headline 契约等问题。深度研究技能 `meld-deepresearch` 增加了渲染、合并与校验环节、体裁模板、访问受阻来源的显式处理以及 SenseNova 能力差距分析，并发布了 v0.2.0、v0.3.0、v0.4.0 三个版本。`sopen-translate` 从零起步，做成 MV3 翻译扩展，包含协议层、预设、术语表流水线、分块双语页面渲染、熔断与冒烟测试，后来去掉了划词翻译只保留整页翻译。

`opencode-skill-management` 实现了 `skill_management` 插件的 list、inspect、disable、enable 四个动作，修订规范并做了可行性评测，发布 v0.2.0、v1.0.0、v1.1.0，最后一版把所有动作改为返回单个 JSON 对象并声明输出 schema。`opencode-agent-sandbox` 完成初始化，写入 AGENTS.md 和知识库，归档 OpenCode V2 的分发、架构、认证、Windows 路径坑以及远程分支删除风险。`opencode-go-model-picker` 新增 agent 发现与快照摘要脚本、原子化快照写入、版本漂移检查和计价核算，发布 v1.3.0、v1.4.0、v2.0.0。`asset-inventory` 修正了规则、样例和指南中的技能调用说明，发布 v1.15.4 和 v1.15.5；`myBlog` 只新增了 OpenChamber 截图。

### 上游工作

上游活动以报告问题为主。在 `openchamber/openchamber` 提交了大量缺陷与想法，涉及存储管理、MCP 设置列表、会话保留提示、引用卡片跳转、文件视图评论、上下文面板占比、截图分辨率、issue 关联和模型思考等级。在 `anomalyco/opencode` 的报告集中在 Go 端点的 MiMo 视觉模型、子代理失败以及 Windows 缺少 CLI 入口。另有少量报告提交到 `alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim`、`iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI`、`OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills` 和 `OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills-DeepResearch`。`antongulin/opencode-skill-creator` 关闭了 4 个 PR，涉及 CRLF frontmatter 校验、按平台打开评审链接、插件卸载时释放评审服务器以及评测健壮性。

### 数据说明

本窗口较早的日期通过 GitHub Search 回溯重建，因此星标数不可用，发布信息仅覆盖本人仓库，这些日期的 issue 与讨论数据为近似值。

highlights.text: 发布 v0.4.0，用 meld.py 把六个校验脚本收拢到 prepare、render、review 三个子命令之后。
发布 v1.1.0，skill_management 的四个动作全部改为返回单个 JSON 对象，并按声明的输出 schema 校验。
发布 v2.0.0，加入计价核算、quota-math 参考文档和最小安装包。
关闭了一个 PR，让技能 frontmatter 校验接受 CRLF 换行。
提交缺陷报告：设置中的 MCP 列表遗漏了 OpenCode 运行时添加的 Console MCP 服务器。
报告 mimo-v2.6-flash 与 mimo-v2.5 声明支持图片输入，但 Go 端点对所有图片返回 400。
日报的 AI 叙述生成失败，以 ai-failure 为标题记录在 issue 中。
